dispute_ticket.description: I matched with a driver and cancelled within about a minute because the pickup pin was wrong. I was still charged $4.00. The cancel screen was also slow and glitchy. Please refund the fee.

chat_logs.content: Sorry the pin is at the wrong entrance, can you go to Bishan Place side?

app_events.details: Rider cancelled the trip 3 min 04 s after matching.
Cancel confirmation screen took 1.2 s to load; no effect on the cancellation time recorded.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only. The limit counts: a cancellation at exactly 3 min 00 s is still free.

cancellation_fee_after_driver_assigned.text: The cancellation fee in SGD for a rider who cancels after a driver has been assigned and outside any free window. It governs rider cancellations only.

no_fee_if_driver_delayed_beyond_eta_min.text: Governs a rider who cancels while the driver is late. It sets the minutes past the driver's shown arrival time after which the rider owes no cancellation fee.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: The driver was matched at 10:15:20 and the rider cancel was recorded at 10:18:24, which is 3 min 04 s after matching. This trip's policy makes cancellation free only up to exactly 3 min 00 s after matching, so the cancel fell 4 seconds outside the window and the S$4.00 fee applies. The rider's 'about a minute' is wrong. The driver was not late (ETA 6 min, shown arrival 10:21:20, rider cancelled before it), so the driver-delay exemption does not apply. The wrong pin and the 1.2 s slow cancel screen do not change the recorded cancel time.
